title: Stuxnet's Windows shortcut flaw disclosed
desc: Microsoft published Security Advisory 2286198 for the Windows shortcut vulnerability exploited by the malware later named Stuxnet.

title: Ukraine power grid attack
desc: About 225,000 customers of three Ukrainian distribution companies lost power after their control systems were remotely compromised (SANS/E-ISAC report).

title: CVE program federates to many numbering authorities
desc: CVE Numbering Authorities grew from 24 at the start of 2016 to 78 in 2017 as the program shifted away from mostly MITRE-issued records. No single dated event.

title: WannaCry outbreak
desc: A self-spreading ransomware worm hit organizations worldwide, including NHS services in England (UK National Audit Office).

title: NotPetya outbreak
desc: US-CERT reported multiple Petya ransomware infections affecting organizations in many countries.

title: TRITON safety-system malware reported
desc: FireEye published analysis of malware built to tamper with Triconex safety instrumented system controllers at a critical infrastructure site.

title: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic
desc: The WHO Director-General said COVID-19 can be characterized as a pandemic.

title: SolarWinds compromise: CISA Emergency Directive 21-01
desc: CISA ordered federal civilian agencies to disconnect or power down compromised SolarWinds Orion products.

title: Colonial Pipeline halts operations after ransomware
desc: Colonial Pipeline stopped pipeline operations after a ransomware attack; its statement said containment actions affected some of its IT systems.

title: CISA BOD 22-01 creates the KEV catalog
desc: CISA required federal agencies to remediate vulnerabilities listed in a new Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

title: Log4Shell disclosed
desc: CVE-2021-44228, a remote code execution flaw in the Apache Log4j library, was published.

title: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine
desc: Russia began a full-scale military invasion of Ukraine. Shown as a reference date only; no causal claim is made.

title: MOVEit Transfer zero-day disclosed
desc: Progress disclosed a SQL injection flaw (CVE-2023-34362) in MOVEit Transfer that was already being exploited, with exploitation dating to at least May 27.

title: NVD announces CVE analysis delays
desc: A notice on the NVD website said to expect delays in CVE analysis during a program transition. Date confirmed by secondary reporting; NIST's own page was not reachable for verification.

title: CrowdStrike content update outage (non-malicious)
desc: A faulty Falcon sensor configuration update crashed Windows hosts worldwide, disrupting airlines among others.

title: CVE program funding lapse averted
desc: After MITRE warned its CVE contract would expire, CISA exercised an 11-month option period the day it was due to lapse.
